intro.speaker: Harold
intro.text: You must be the new pastor. I'm Harold. I've had a key to this room since the carpet was another red.

intro_lock.speaker: Harold
intro_lock.text: I don't hand keys out on a first afternoon. The office lock sticks. It needs patience, not replacing.

directed.speaker: Harold
directed.text: Margaret sent you. The spare ring is on the stacked chairs. I was checking the lock, not hiding them.

hint.speaker: Harold
hint.text: Looking for the spare ring? I set it on the stacked chairs. The lock sticks. That's a repair, not a new lock.

already_holding.speaker: Harold
already_holding.text: You have the ring. Take it back to Margaret. She trusts the hook more than she trusts my pockets.

after_lock.speaker: Harold
after_lock.text: The ring is back with Margaret. Leave the office lock alone until it fails twice, not once.

request_fence_busy.speaker: Harold
request_fence_busy.text: You've got enough jobs. The fence will still be leaning tomorrow.

request_fence_ask.speaker: Harold
request_fence_ask.text: A stretch of the garden fence is tired. Three boards and two handfuls of nails would set it.

choices.text: I'll get the wood and nails.

request_fence_accepted.speaker: Harold
request_fence_accepted.text: Bring them here. I'll set the boards. Don't make a project of it.

request_fence_wait.speaker: Harold
request_fence_wait.text: Wood and nails. Three and two. Hardware has both if the shed doesn't.

request_fence_deliver.speaker: Harold
request_fence_deliver.text: That'll hold. I left a bit of scrap by the post if you want it.

request_fence_done.speaker: Harold
request_fence_done.text: The garden fence is set. Leave it. A fence that gets fussed over starts expecting it.
